prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: A family camping safely near a forest lake, tent, rocks and a hiking trail. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Forest Camp". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Forest, lake, tent and camp.
Hike the hill with one small light.
Rock and stone beside the wood.
Climb with care, the air can feel good.
Fire for the adult, stand back.
Join the group along the track.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
